The `omnirag` command is installed with the package. Run `omnirag COMMAND --help` for the same
information in the terminal.

**Global option:** `--data-dir` / `-d PATH` (or the `OMNIRAG_HOME` environment variable)
selects where knowledge bases live; the default is `~/.omnirag`. It goes before the command:
`omnirag -d ./data kb list`. Commands that take `--kb` / `-b` default to the knowledge base
named by `OMNIRAG_KB`, or `default`.

| Command | Description |
| ------- | ----------- |
| [`omnirag kb create`](#omnirag-kb-create) | Create a new knowledge base |
| [`omnirag kb list`](#omnirag-kb-list) | List knowledge bases |
| [`omnirag kb delete`](#omnirag-kb-delete) | Delete a knowledge base and all of its data (source files are not touched) |
| [`omnirag kb rebuild`](#omnirag-kb-rebuild) | Re-embed all chunks (e.g. after changing the embedder) |
| [`omnirag kb prune`](#omnirag-kb-prune) | Remove documents whose source files no longer exist |
| [`omnirag ingest`](#omnirag-ingest) | Ingest files into a knowledge base (incremental: unchanged files are skipped) |
| [`omnirag query`](#omnirag-query) | Ask a question and get an answer with [n] citations |
| [`omnirag search`](#omnirag-search) | Retrieval only: show the ranked chunks without generating an answer |
| [`omnirag stats`](#omnirag-stats) | Show knowledge base statistics |
| [`omnirag remove`](#omnirag-remove) | Remove one document from a knowledge base |
| [`omnirag serve`](#omnirag-serve) | Start the API server and web UI |
| [`omnirag doctor`](#omnirag-doctor) | Check Python, the data dir, the embedder, model servers and optional extras |

## `omnirag kb create`

Create a new knowledge base.

```bash
omnirag kb create NAME [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `NAME` | text | Knowledge base name. |

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--description` | text |  | Free-form description. |
| `--embedder` / `-e` | text |  | hashing[:dim] (default), st:&lt;hf-model&gt; or ollama:&lt;model&gt;. |

## `omnirag kb list`

List knowledge bases.

```bash
omnirag kb list
```

## `omnirag kb delete`

Delete a knowledge base and all of its data (source files are not touched).

```bash
omnirag kb delete NAME [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `NAME` | text | Required. |

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--yes` / `-y` | flag |  | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## `omnirag kb rebuild`

Re-embed all chunks (e.g. after changing the embedder).

```bash
omnirag kb rebuild NAME [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `NAME` | text | Required. |

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--embedder` / `-e` | text |  | Switch to a different embedder before rebuilding. |

## `omnirag kb prune`

Remove documents whose source files no longer exist.

```bash
omnirag kb prune NAME
```

| Argument | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `NAME` | text | Required. |

## `omnirag ingest`

Ingest files into a knowledge base (incremental: unchanged files are skipped).

```bash
omnirag ingest PATHS... [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `PATHS` | text, one or more | Files and/or directories to ingest. |

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--kb` / `-b` | text | `default` | Knowledge base name. Env: `OMNIRAG_KB`. |
| `--recursive` / `--no-recursive` | flag | --recursive | Recurse into dirs. |
| `--force` | flag |  | Re-ingest even unchanged files. |
| `--create` / `--no-create` | flag | --create | Create the KB if missing. |
| `--quiet` / `-q` | flag |  | Only print the summary. |

## `omnirag query`

Ask a question and get an answer with [n] citations.

```bash
omnirag query QUESTION [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `QUESTION` | text | Question. Inline filters like modality:code work too. |

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--kb` / `-b` | text | `default` | Knowledge base name. Env: `OMNIRAG_KB`. |
| `--llm` / `-l` | text |  | none (extractive, default), ollama[:model] or openai[:model]. Env: OMNIRAG_LLM. |
| `--top-k` / `-k` | integer 1–50 | `5` | Number of sources. |
| `--modality` / `-m` | text, repeatable |  | Restrict modality. |
| `--source` / `-s` | text, repeatable |  | Source glob/substring. |
| `--mode` | text | `hybrid` | Retrieval mode: hybrid, dense, bm25. |
| `--neighbors` | integer 0–3 | `1` | Neighbour chunks for context. |
| `--hyde` | flag |  | Use HyDE query expansion (needs an LLM). |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print the full result as JSON. |
| `--sources` / `--no-sources` | flag | --sources | Print the source list. |

## `omnirag search`

Retrieval only: show the ranked chunks without generating an answer.

```bash
omnirag search TEXT [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `TEXT` | text | Search text (inline filters supported). |

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--kb` / `-b` | text | `default` | Knowledge base name. Env: `OMNIRAG_KB`. |
| `--top-k` / `-k` | integer 1–100 | `10` |  |
| `--modality` / `-m` | text, repeatable |  |  |
| `--mode` | text | `hybrid` | Retrieval mode: hybrid, dense, bm25. |
| `--json` | flag |  |  |

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--kb` / `-b` | text | `default` | Knowledge base name. Env: `OMNIRAG_KB`. |

## `omnirag remove`

Remove one document from a knowledge base.

```bash
omnirag remove SOURCE [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `SOURCE` | text | Source path or doc id. |

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--kb` / `-b` | text | `default` | Knowledge base name. Env: `OMNIRAG_KB`. |

## `omnirag serve`

Start the API server and web UI.

```bash
omnirag serve [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--host` | text | `127.0.0.1` | Bind address. |
| `--port` / `-p` | integer 1–65535 | `8000` | Port. |
| `--kb` / `-b` | text | `default` | Knowledge base name. Env: `OMNIRAG_KB`. |

## `omnirag doctor`

Check Python, the data dir, the embedder, model servers and optional extras.

```bash
omnirag doctor [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ------- | ----------- |
| `--network` / `--no-network` | flag | --network | Probe Ollama / OpenAI-compatible endpoints. |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print the checks as JSON. |
